name: Organic Tomatoes
description: Fresh, juicy organic tomatoes grown locally. Perfect for salads, sauces, and sandwiches. Packed with vitamins and antioxidants.

name: Fresh Carrots
description: Crisp and sweet carrots, rich in beta-carotene. Great for snacking, roasting, or adding to soups and stews.

name: Potatoes
description: Versatile and hearty potatoes, perfect for baking, mashing, or roasting. A staple ingredient for countless dishes.

name: Green Broccoli
description: Nutrient-dense broccoli florets, packed with vitamins C and K. Excellent steamed, roasted, or stir-fried.

name: Bell Peppers Mix
description: Colorful mix of red, yellow, and green bell peppers. Sweet and crunchy, perfect for grilling or adding to any dish.

name: Leafy Spinach
description: Fresh organic spinach leaves, iron-rich and versatile. Ideal for salads, smoothies, or sautéing as a side dish.

name: Red Onions
description: Sharp and flavorful red onions, essential for any kitchen. Great raw in salads or caramelized for added depth.
